title: The Cross
reflectionQuestion: What do you think it means to be loved as much as Jesus loves you?
kidSafetyNotes: THE hard story, told via the Joseph method (feedback_kid_god_with_not_cause). LOVE-centered, not suffering-centered: death stated softly ('his breath grew still'); NO nails/blood/gore. Jesus's real words kept ('Father, forgive them'; 'into your hands'). Names that God had NOT left ('there in the dark') and refuses to end in the dark -- ends forward ('Sunday was coming'), gently pointing to Easter (1812). Grounding image: his mother Mary among the watchers (threads to 1824). Mood=hurting: the comfort for a sad child is 'Jesus knows sadness, loves you this much, and God did not leave.' Adam: braver-set centerpiece; reviewed line-by-line.
